name: Clockwork Sentinel, Common
body:
CLOCKWORK SENTINEL
CR 3

This man-sized figure formed from metal stands absolutely stationary, with only a steady hum giving away the presence of clockwork within.

XP 800
N Medium construct
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +2 dodge)
hp 42 (4d10+20)
Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +2
Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 1 slam +7 (1d8+3)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 16, Con -, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +4; CMB +4, CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Clockwork Wind-up (Ex)

As a move action the Clockwork Sentinel can wind up its second arm. Once wound then on its next turn it has the ability to make a full attack, gaining a second slam attack with the same statistics as the first.
